hepatitis B virus preS mutants in liver tissues and plasma.
the application of a novel NGS-based approach for detecting pre-S mutants as potential HCC markers in plasma.
the detection of pre-S mutant hepatitis B virus (pre-S mutant HBV) in liver tissues of hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC) patients, using next-generation sequencing-based analysis of patient plasma.

the NGS platform can be used as a noninvasive tool for detection of preS mutants and their patterns in clinical practice.

we have developed a new platform to detect HBV pre-S mutants in patients' plasma by using the NGS technology.
